messages:
maria/docs: FYI I opened a PR to switch the audit-log examples to JSONL and add SDK migration snippets for Ruby + Python: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood-docs/pull/3422

alex-legal: Thanks — can you put the SOC2 phrasing behind an explicit note? We should avoid absolute words like 'never' or 'permanent' in the public docs. Example: replace 'logs are kept permanently' -> 'logs are retained as described in your contract; customers may request exports or legal holds.'

raj-devex: Quick glance at the PR — code snippets look good but the Python example needs an explicit newline between records for JSONL. Current sample uses print(json.dumps(event)) without '\n' which can break some importers. Suggest:
```
for event in events:
    print(json.dumps(event))  # ensure newline-delimited JSON
```

sam-infra: CI caught a schema mismatch on the example payloads: failing validator: "missing field: tenant_id" in example 3. Patch incoming unless we intentionally left it out for anonymization.

maria/docs: Good catch @sam-infra. I intentionally redacted tenant_id in one sample to avoid customer data smells, but we should show the canonical schema elsewhere and call out redaction in a separate note. Would legal be okay with that split?

alex-legal: Split is fine. Public docs: show canonical schema with placeholders (e.g., "tenant_id": "<REDACTED_FOR_EXAMPLE>") and add a short note about PII removal best practices and SOC2 alignment. Also add a one-liner about retention language: 'Retention aligns with customer contract and applicable laws; contact sales for enterprise retention options.'

raj-devex: I'll update the Python and Ruby snippets and add a tiny migration section: bullet list of 1) JSON -> JSONL change, 2) ensure tenant_id placeholder, 3) update SDK helpers (we're adding a helper method in the client: client.audit_log_write(record)). Draft snippet for Ruby: 
```
records.each do |r|
  puts r.to_json
end
```

maria/docs: Awesome. Can we also add a short mdx admonition for 'Redaction vs schema' so users know which fields to remove for demo data vs which fields are required by the API?

sam-infra: I'm putting up a small test fix for the examples now — will also add a unit test that validates example JSONL against the schema so this doesn't slip again. ETA ~30m. :hammer_and_wrench:

ci-bot: CI / docs-lint — 1 failed job. Failure details: docs-snippets-validator: example-sets/audit-log/examples.jsonl: record 3 -> missing "tenant_id" (required). Triggered by PR #3422

maria/docs: Thanks @ci-bot and @sam-infra. Once tests pass, I'll request a final review from @alex-legal and then merge. Can we also verify internal link targets? I noticed one link to the retention policy doc is pointing at /legal/retention (should be /legal/data-retention).

alex-legal: Confirmed — update link text to 'Data retention and legal holds' and target /legal/data-retention. Also suggest adding the short legal contact flow: 'For retention exceptions or legal holds, contact legal@redwood.ai with the case ID.'

raj-devex: I'll push the snippet and MDX admonition commit (docs + examples) in one PR update. I'll also append a short migration checklist for engineers using older SDKs (v0.x -> v1.x): note JSON -> JSONL, method rename client.log_event -> client.audit_log_write, and sample env var for retention TTL: REDWOOD_AUDIT_RETENTION_DAYS.

maria/docs: Perfect. After merge I'll spin a tiny changelog entry for the SDK migration note so customers see it in the next release notes.

sam-infra: Fix merged to branch, CI re-run queued. :rocket:

ci-bot: CI / docs-lint — all checks passed. examples.jsonl validated, links OK.

maria/docs: Thanks everyone. I'll open the final PR comment and tag @product for visibility. Closing this thread once merged. :white_check_mark:

alex-legal: Thx — leaving one small nit in the PR itself about wording, but otherwise LGTM.

raj-devex: Nice teamwork.
